title: Design System: UP GEOP Applicant Portal

display.purpose: Hero portal title, milestone percentage figures, and timer readouts in Fraunces serif.

headline.purpose: Section headers and modal titles in Fraunces serif.

body.purpose: Standard task and instruction text in Figtree sans-serif.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Resting grounding for cards on parchment canvas.

shadows.name: modal-elevation
shadows.purpose: Elevated modal dialogs and overlay boxes.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition timing for button hover and tab activation.

components.name: Primary Checkin Button
components.description: High-priority action button for check-ins, validation, and task completion.
components.css: .btn-checkin { background: #C1272D; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .btn-checkin:hover { background: #A02025; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Muted action button for filters, cancellation, and copy actions.
components.css: .btn-secondary { background: #EBE5DA; color: #111111; border: 1px solid #C4B9A3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .btn-secondary:hover { background: #DCD4C5; }

components.name: Signpost Tab
components.description: Navigation tab button in horizontally scrollable top bar.
components.css: .tab-btn { background: #EBE5DA; border: 1px solid #C4B9A3; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; color: #111111; } .tab-btn.active { background: #C1272D; color: #ffffff; border-color: #C1272D; }

components.name: Enamel Badge
components.description: Pill tag for role designation, progress counters, and status tags.
components.css: .badge { background: #EBE5DA; color: #111111; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #C4B9A3; display: inline-block; }

narrative.overview: The UP GEOP Applicant Portal marries the meticulous record-keeping of a geodetic surveyor's field notebook with the communal, vibrant energy of Filipino commuter culture (Biyahe — 'Kasya pa, sakay na!'). Rather than treating applicant evaluation as an intimidating corporate pipeline, the system visualizes progress as a shared transit route and an unfolding survey control network.

rules.name: The Signpost Rule
rules.body: Crimson (#C1272D) is reserved exclusively for active waypoints and primary actions; it must never coat passive background cards.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Blur Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth and section separation rely on 1px solid structural borders and subtle tone rather than heavy multi-layer blur shadows.

dos: Do preserve the warm Manila paper canvas (#F4F1EB) as the primary background for all public views.
Do maintain a minimum touch target size of 44×44px for primary mobile interaction buttons.
Do use Fraunces serif font for major headings, progress percentages, and numeric counters.
Do provide alphanumeric text fallbacks alongside all visual network graphs and QR codes.
donts: Don't introduce cold blue-gray tech gradients, glassmorphism, or sterile generic corporate SaaS styles.
Don't use Jeepney Crimson for decorative background fills or inactive list rows; preserve it for active waypoints and actions.
Don't hide verification progress behind ambiguous icons; always pair visual icons with explicit numeric progress.
Don't use unreadable novelty or handwriting display fonts that compromise rapid mobile validation in outdoor sunlight.
